title: هل من المقبول إذا
form: Is it okay if + subject + verb ... ?

cells.en: Is it okay if I open the window?
cells.ar: هل من المقبول إذا فتحت النافذة؟
cells.description: An adult politely asking another adult for permission. Specific context: Is it okay if I open the window? No captions or written speech.

cells.en: Is it okay if we sit here?
cells.ar: هل من المقبول إذا جلسنا هنا؟
cells.description: An adult politely asking another adult for permission. Specific context: Is it okay if we sit here? No captions or written speech.

cells.en: Is it okay if I call you later?
cells.ar: هل يناسبك إذا اتصلت بك لاحقًا؟
cells.description: An adult politely asking another adult for permission. Specific context: Is it okay if I call you later? No captions or written speech.

cells.en: Is it okay if I take a photo?
cells.ar: هل من المقبول إذا التقطت صورة؟
cells.description: An adult politely asking another adult for permission. Specific context: Is it okay if I take a photo? No captions or written speech.

cells.en: Is it okay if I use this chair?
cells.ar: هل تسمح لي باستخدام هذا الكرسي؟
cells.description: An adult asking a seated person about an empty chair.

cells.en: Is it okay if we start five minutes later?
cells.ar: هل يناسبك أن نبدأ بعد خمس دقائق؟
cells.description: Two colleagues checking their watches before a meeting.

cells.en: Is it okay if I bring my younger brother?
cells.ar: هل من المقبول أن أحضر أخي الأصغر؟
cells.description: An adult asking a host about bringing a younger brother.

cells.en: Is it okay if she waits in the reception area?
cells.ar: هل يُسمح لها بالانتظار في منطقة الاستقبال؟
cells.description: An adult asking a receptionist about a waiting visitor.

cells.en: Is it okay if I charge my phone here?
cells.ar: هل تسمح لي بشحن هاتفي هنا؟
cells.description: An adult holding a phone charger beside an unused socket.

cells.en: Is it okay if we share this table?
cells.ar: هل يمكننا مشاركة هذه الطاولة؟
cells.description: Two cafe visitors asking to share a table with another customer.

cells.en: Is it okay if I leave my bag here until lunch?
cells.ar: هل يُسمح لي بترك حقيبتي هنا حتى الغداء؟
cells.description: An adult asking a staff member where to leave a bag.

cells.en: Is it okay if I ask one more question before you go?
cells.ar: هل تسمح لي بطرح سؤال آخر قبل أن تذهب؟
cells.description: An adult politely stopping a departing colleague to ask a question.

cells.en: You may enter the room now.
cells.ar: يمكنك دخول الغرفة الآن.
cells.description: A staff member allowing a visitor into a room.

cells.en: You may use this computer.
cells.ar: يُسمح لك باستخدام هذا الحاسوب.
cells.description: A staff member giving a visitor permission to use a computer.

cells.en: You may leave after the lesson.
cells.ar: يمكنك المغادرة بعد الدرس.
cells.description: A teacher giving adult learners permission to leave after class.

cells.en: You may borrow this book.
cells.ar: يمكنك استعارة هذا الكتاب.
cells.description: A librarian permitting a visitor to borrow a book.

cells.en: You may take a short break now.
cells.ar: يُسمح لك بأخذ استراحة قصيرة الآن.
cells.description: A supervisor giving a worker permission to take a break.

cells.en: You may sit anywhere in this waiting area.
cells.ar: يُسمح لك بالجلوس في أي مكان في منطقة الانتظار هذه.
cells.description: A receptionist showing a visitor the available waiting seats.

cells.en: You may keep the spare copy.
cells.ar: يُسمح لك بالاحتفاظ بالنسخة الإضافية.
cells.description: A teacher handing an adult learner an extra copy of a worksheet.

cells.en: You may use a dictionary during this activity.
cells.ar: يُسمح لك باستخدام قاموس خلال هذا النشاط.
cells.description: A teacher indicating an open dictionary during an exercise.

cells.en: You may bring one guest to the event.
cells.ar: يُسمح لك بإحضار ضيف واحد إلى الفعالية.
cells.description: An event organizer explaining an invitation to an adult guest.

cells.en: You may park here after six.
cells.ar: يُسمح لك بإيقاف سيارتك هنا بعد السادسة.
cells.description: A parking attendant showing a driver an available parking space.

cells.en: You may ask for more time if you need it.
cells.ar: يمكنك طلب وقت إضافي إذا احتجت إليه.
cells.description: A teacher offering an adult learner additional time.

cells.en: You may leave when you finish, but please return the key first.
cells.ar: يُسمح لك بالمغادرة عندما تنتهي، لكن أعد المفتاح أولًا من فضلك.
cells.description: A supervisor indicating a return-key tray near an exit.

cells.en: I need some water.
cells.ar: أحتاج بعض الماء.
cells.description: An adult asking for a concrete useful item or practical assistance. Specific context: I need some water. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: I need a pencil.
cells.ar: أحتاج قلم رصاص.
cells.description: An adult asking for a concrete useful item or practical assistance. Specific context: I need a pencil. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: I need more time.
cells.ar: أحتاج وقتًا إضافيًا.
cells.description: An adult asking for a concrete useful item or practical assistance. Specific context: I need more time. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: I need your help.
cells.ar: أحتاج مساعدتك.
cells.description: An adult asking for a concrete useful item or practical assistance. Specific context: I need your help. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: I need a quiet place to study.
cells.ar: أحتاج إلى مكان هادئ للدراسة.
cells.description: An adult looking for a quiet study seat in a library.

cells.en: I need a receipt for this purchase.
cells.ar: أحتاج إلى إيصال بهذا الشراء.
cells.description: An adult requesting a receipt at a shop checkout.

cells.en: I need some advice about my course.
cells.ar: أحتاج إلى نصيحة بشأن مقرري الدراسي.
cells.description: An adult learner speaking with a course adviser.

cells.en: I need a larger bag for these books.
cells.ar: أحتاج إلى حقيبة أكبر لهذه الكتب.
cells.description: An adult comparing a small bag with a stack of books.

cells.en: I need clear instructions before I start.
cells.ar: أحتاج إلى تعليمات واضحة قبل أن أبدأ.
cells.description: An adult asking for instructions beside an unfinished assembly kit.

cells.en: I need a few minutes to check the details.
cells.ar: أحتاج إلى بضع دقائق لمراجعة التفاصيل.
cells.description: An adult examining a document while a colleague waits.

cells.en: I need warm clothes for the trip.
cells.ar: أحتاج إلى ملابس دافئة للرحلة.
cells.description: An adult packing warm clothes into a suitcase.

cells.en: I need both your name and your booking number.
cells.ar: أحتاج إلى اسمك ورقم حجزك كليهما.
cells.description: A hotel receptionist asking a visitor for booking details.

title: لست مضطرًا إلى
form: I don't have to + base verb

cells.en: I don't have to wake up early tomorrow.
cells.ar: لست مضطرًا للاستيقاظ مبكرًا غدًا.
cells.description: An adult explaining that an activity is optional. Specific context: I don't have to wake up early tomorrow. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: I don't have to work today.
cells.ar: لست مضطرًا للعمل اليوم.
cells.description: An adult explaining that an activity is optional. Specific context: I don't have to work today. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: I don't have to bring my laptop.
cells.ar: لست مضطرًا لإحضار حاسوبي المحمول.
cells.description: An adult explaining that an activity is optional. Specific context: I don't have to bring my laptop. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: I don't have to pay for this ticket.
cells.ar: لست مضطرًا لدفع ثمن هذه التذكرة.
cells.description: An adult explaining that an activity is optional. Specific context: I don't have to pay for this ticket. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: I don't have to drive because the station is nearby.
cells.ar: لست مضطرًا للقيادة لأن المحطة قريبة.
cells.description: An adult walking toward a nearby station while leaving a car parked.

cells.en: I don't have to wear a uniform at this job.
cells.ar: لست مضطرًا لارتداء زي موحد في هذه الوظيفة.
cells.description: An adult choosing ordinary work clothes from a wardrobe.

cells.en: I don't have to cook tonight; my sister is making dinner.
cells.ar: لست مضطرًا للطهي الليلة؛ فأختي تعد العشاء.
cells.description: An adult relaxing while a sister prepares dinner in a kitchen.

cells.en: I don't have to answer every question immediately.
cells.ar: لست مضطرًا للإجابة عن كل سؤال فورًا.
cells.description: An adult pausing thoughtfully during a discussion.

cells.en: I don't have to print the form; I can send it online.
cells.ar: لست مضطرًا لطباعة الاستمارة؛ إذ يمكنني إرسالها إلكترونيًا.
cells.description: An adult submitting a form on a laptop beside an unused printer.

cells.en: I don't have to buy a new copy because the library has one.
cells.ar: لست مضطرًا لشراء نسخة جديدة لأن المكتبة لديها نسخة.
cells.description: An adult borrowing a book at a library counter.

cells.en: I don't have to finish this until Friday.
cells.ar: لست مضطرًا لإنهاء هذا قبل يوم الجمعة.
cells.description: An adult checking a later deadline on a work calendar.

cells.en: I don't have to attend, but I can go if I am interested.
cells.ar: لست مضطرًا للحضور، لكن يمكنني الذهاب إذا كنت مهتمًا.
cells.description: An adult considering an optional workshop invitation.

cells.en: I must finish my work today.
cells.ar: يجب عليّ إنهاء عملي اليوم.
cells.description: An adult preparing to fulfill an important commitment. Specific context: I must finish my work today. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: I must remember this password.
cells.ar: يجب عليّ تذكر كلمة المرور هذه.
cells.description: An adult preparing to fulfill an important commitment. Specific context: I must remember this password. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: I must wear my seat belt.
cells.ar: يجب عليّ وضع حزام الأمان.
cells.description: An adult preparing to fulfill an important commitment. Specific context: I must wear my seat belt. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: I must tell the truth.
cells.ar: يجب عليّ قول الحقيقة.
cells.description: An adult preparing to fulfill an important commitment. Specific context: I must tell the truth. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: I must leave now to catch the last train.
cells.ar: يجب أن أغادر الآن لألحق بالقطار الأخير.
cells.description: A traveler checking the time and picking up a suitcase.

cells.en: I must keep this medicine out of reach of children.
cells.ar: يجب أن أبقي هذا الدواء بعيدًا عن متناول الأطفال.
cells.description: An adult placing a medicine container in a high locked cupboard.

cells.en: I must charge my phone before the trip.
cells.ar: يجب أن أشحن هاتفي قبل الرحلة.
cells.description: An adult plugging in a phone beside a packed travel bag.

cells.en: I must check that the door is locked.
cells.ar: يجب أن أتأكد من أن الباب مقفل.
cells.description: An adult checking a front-door lock before leaving.

cells.en: I must send the application before the deadline.
cells.ar: يجب أن أرسل الطلب قبل انتهاء الموعد المحدد.
cells.description: An adult preparing to submit an application on a laptop.

cells.en: I must apologize for my mistake.
cells.ar: يجب أن أعتذر عن خطئي.
cells.description: An adult sincerely apologizing to a colleague.

cells.en: I must follow the safety instructions in this workshop.
cells.ar: يجب أن أتبع تعليمات السلامة في هذه الورشة.
cells.description: An adult putting on protective equipment in a workshop.

cells.en: I must finish the report today, even if I need to ask for help.
cells.ar: يجب أن أنهي التقرير اليوم حتى لو احتجت إلى طلب المساعدة.
cells.description: An adult working on a report while asking a colleague for assistance.

cells.en: I should sleep earlier.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن أنام أبكر.
cells.description: An adult considering a sensible next action. Specific context: I should sleep earlier. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: I should practice more.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن أتدرب أكثر.
cells.description: An adult considering a sensible next action. Specific context: I should practice more. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: I should call my grandparents.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن أتصل بجدي وجدتي.
cells.description: An adult considering a sensible next action. Specific context: I should call my grandparents. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: I should drink more water.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن أشرب ماءً أكثر.
cells.description: An adult considering a sensible next action. Specific context: I should drink more water. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: I should check the address before I book a taxi.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن أراجع العنوان قبل أن أحجز سيارة أجرة.
cells.description: An adult comparing an address with a taxi-booking screen.

cells.en: I should spend less time looking at my phone.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن أقضي وقتًا أقل في النظر إلى هاتفي.
cells.description: An adult putting down a phone beside an unread book.

cells.en: I should ask for clarification instead of guessing.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن أطلب توضيحًا بدلًا من التخمين.
cells.description: An adult learner raising a hand to clarify an instruction.

cells.en: I should save a copy of this document.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن أحفظ نسخة من هذه الوثيقة.
cells.description: An adult making a backup copy of a document on a laptop.

cells.en: I should tell them if my plans change.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن أخبرهم إذا تغيرت خططي.
cells.description: An adult preparing to message friends about a changed schedule.

cells.en: I should take an umbrella because it might rain.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن آخذ مظلة لأن المطر قد يهطل.
cells.description: An adult taking an umbrella while looking at cloudy weather.

cells.en: I should review the words I learned yesterday.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن أراجع الكلمات التي تعلمتها أمس.
cells.description: An adult reviewing vocabulary notes from a previous lesson.

cells.en: I should rest for a while, then return to the task.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن أستريح قليلًا، ثم أعود إلى المهمة.
cells.description: An adult stepping away from a study desk for a short break.

cells.en: You should ask the teacher.
cells.ar: ينبغي لك سؤال المعلم.
cells.description: One adult offering practical advice to another. Specific context: You should ask the teacher. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: You should take a short break.
cells.ar: ينبغي لك أخذ استراحة قصيرة.
cells.description: One adult offering practical advice to another. Specific context: You should take a short break. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: You should check your answer.
cells.ar: ينبغي لك مراجعة إجابتك.
cells.description: One adult offering practical advice to another. Specific context: You should check your answer. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: You should try again.
cells.ar: ينبغي لك المحاولة مرة أخرى.
cells.description: One adult offering practical advice to another. Specific context: You should try again. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: You should read the whole question before you answer.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن تقرأ السؤال كاملًا قبل أن تجيب.
cells.description: A teacher pointing to a question while advising an adult learner.

cells.en: You should leave early if you want a good seat.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن تغادر مبكرًا إذا أردت مقعدًا جيدًا.
cells.description: Two adults discussing when to leave for an event.

cells.en: You should compare the prices before you buy it.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن تقارن الأسعار قبل أن تشتريه.
cells.description: Two adults comparing similar products in a shop.

cells.en: You should keep a copy of your booking.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن تحتفظ بنسخة من حجزك.
cells.description: An adult showing a friend how to save a booking confirmation.

cells.en: You should ask someone who knows the area.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن تسأل شخصًا يعرف المنطقة.
cells.description: A traveler asking a local person for advice.

cells.en: You should practice saying the sentence aloud.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن تتدرب على قول الجملة بصوت عالٍ.
cells.description: A teacher encouraging an adult learner to speak aloud.

cells.en: You should let us know if you cannot come.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن تخبرنا إذا لم تتمكن من المجيء.
cells.description: An event organizer speaking to an invited guest.

cells.en: You should try a simpler example before you attempt this one.
cells.ar: ينبغي أن تجرب مثالًا أبسط قبل أن تحاول حل هذا المثال.
cells.description: A teacher showing an adult learner an easier practice exercise.

cells.en: Let me help you.
cells.ar: دعني أساعدك.
cells.description: An adult offering to carry out a useful action for another person. Specific context: Let me help you. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: Let me explain the answer.
cells.ar: دعني أشرح الإجابة.
cells.description: An adult offering to carry out a useful action for another person. Specific context: Let me explain the answer. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: Let me open the door.
cells.ar: دعني أفتح الباب.
cells.description: An adult offering to carry out a useful action for another person. Specific context: Let me open the door. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: Let me check my schedule.
cells.ar: دعني أتحقق من جدولي.
cells.description: An adult offering to carry out a useful action for another person. Specific context: Let me check my schedule. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: Let me show you where the station is.
cells.ar: دعني أريك أين المحطة.
cells.description: An adult pointing out a railway station on a map.

cells.en: Let me finish this sentence before you reply.
cells.ar: دعني أنهي هذه الجملة قبل أن ترد.
cells.description: An adult politely holding up a hand during a conversation.

cells.en: Let me move this chair out of your way.
cells.ar: دعني أبعد هذا الكرسي عن طريقك.
cells.description: An adult moving a chair to clear a passage for someone.

cells.en: Let me write that number down.
cells.ar: دعني أدوّن ذلك الرقم.
cells.description: An adult writing a number in a small notebook during a call.

cells.en: Let me find a quieter place to talk.
cells.ar: دعني أجد مكانًا أهدأ للحديث.
cells.description: An adult leaving a noisy cafe area during a phone call.

cells.en: Let me check whether the package has arrived.
cells.ar: دعني أتحقق مما إذا كان الطرد قد وصل.
cells.description: An adult checking delivery information beside a front door.

cells.en: Let me try once more before you help me.
cells.ar: دعني أحاول مرة أخرى قبل أن تساعدني.
cells.description: An adult learner trying a practical task while a teacher waits.

cells.en: Let me explain why I chose this option.
cells.ar: دعني أشرح لماذا اخترت هذا الخيار.
cells.description: An adult presenting a choice and explaining it to a small group.

title: من فضلك
form: Please + base verb / base verb ..., please / Could you + base verb ..., please?

cells.en: Close the door, please.
cells.ar: من فضلك أغلق الباب.
cells.description: An adult making a polite practical request. Specific context: Close the door, please. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: Wait a moment, please.
cells.ar: من فضلك انتظر لحظة.
cells.description: An adult making a polite practical request. Specific context: Wait a moment, please. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: Speak slowly, please.
cells.ar: من فضلك تحدث ببطء.
cells.description: An adult making a polite practical request. Specific context: Speak slowly, please. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: Show me the way, please.
cells.ar: من فضلك أرشدني إلى الطريق.
cells.description: An adult making a polite practical request. Specific context: Show me the way, please. No captions or written speech.

cells.en: Please put your bags under the table.
cells.ar: ضعوا حقائبكم تحت الطاولة من فضلكم.
cells.description: An adult staff member showing visitors where to place their bags.

cells.en: Please write your name at the top of the page.
cells.ar: اكتب اسمك في أعلى الصفحة من فضلك.
cells.description: A teacher indicating the top of a worksheet to an adult learner.

cells.en: Please let me know if you need help.
cells.ar: أخبرني إذا احتجت إلى مساعدة من فضلك.
cells.description: An adult host offering help to a visitor.

cells.en: Please turn the volume down a little.
cells.ar: اخفض الصوت قليلًا من فضلك.
cells.description: An adult politely gesturing toward a speaker volume control.

cells.en: Please wait until everyone is ready.
cells.ar: انتظر حتى يستعد الجميع من فضلك.
cells.description: An adult asking a group to pause before starting an activity.

cells.en: Please send the details before tomorrow's meeting.
cells.ar: أرسل التفاصيل قبل اجتماع الغد من فضلك.
cells.description: Two colleagues discussing a document before a scheduled meeting.

cells.en: Could you check the date, please?
cells.ar: هل يمكنك مراجعة التاريخ من فضلك؟
cells.description: An adult asking a receptionist to check a date on a booking.

cells.en: Please take your time and read each step carefully.
cells.ar: خذ وقتك واقرأ كل خطوة بعناية من فضلك.
cells.description: A teacher calmly guiding an adult learner through instructions.

cells.en: Would you like some tea?
cells.ar: هل ترغب في بعض الشاي؟
cells.description: An adult offering another person an item or help. Specific context: Would you like some tea? No captions or written speech.

cells.en: Would you like a sandwich?
cells.ar: هل تود شطيرة؟
cells.description: An adult offering another person an item or help. Specific context: Would you like a sandwich? No captions or written speech.

cells.en: Would you like some water?
cells.ar: هل ترغب في بعض الماء؟
cells.description: An adult offering another person an item or help. Specific context: Would you like some water? No captions or written speech.

cells.en: Would you like another book?
cells.ar: هل ترغب في كتاب آخر؟
cells.description: An adult offering another person an item or help. Specific context: Would you like another book? No captions or written speech.

cells.en: Would you like a seat near the window?
cells.ar: هل ترغب في مقعد قرب النافذة؟
cells.description: A host offering a visitor an empty window-side chair.

cells.en: Would you like some help with those bags?
cells.ar: هل تود بعض المساعدة في حمل تلك الحقائب؟
cells.description: An adult offering to carry a traveler's bags.

cells.en: Would you like a copy of the notes?
cells.ar: هل ترغب في نسخة من الملاحظات؟
cells.description: An adult offering a classmate a copy of lesson notes.

cells.en: Would you like a little more rice?
cells.ar: هل ترغب في مزيد قليل من الأرز؟
cells.description: An adult offering another serving of rice at a meal.

cells.en: Would you like milk with your coffee?
cells.ar: هل ترغب في حليب مع قهوتك؟
cells.description: A cafe worker offering milk beside a cup of coffee.

cells.en: Would you like a map of the town?
cells.ar: هل ترغب في خريطة للبلدة؟
cells.description: A visitor-center worker offering a traveler a folded map.

cells.en: Would you like the blue folder or the green one?
cells.ar: هل ترغب في المجلد الأزرق أم الأخضر؟
cells.description: An adult offering two colored folders to a colleague.

cells.en: Would you like some extra time before we begin?
cells.ar: هل ترغب في وقت إضافي قبل أن نبدأ؟
cells.description: A teacher offering an adult learner a little more preparation time.
